title: A story told across five messages: nod along, then reply at the end

events.author: alice
events.text: Vigil, you won't believe what happened with the deploy last night.

events.author: alice
events.text: So the canary looked fine for the first ten minutes, error rate flat.

events.author: alice
events.text: Then the token refresh job kicked in and every request from the old pods started failing auth.

events.author: alice
events.text: Turns out the new pods rotated the signing key and the old ones never picked it up, so we rolled back at 2am.

events.author: alice
events.text: Anyway. What would you have done differently?
